description: Canonical test vectors for patent utility prosecution (Appendix B). Generated from Rust SDK reference implementation.
patent_claims: These vectors provide reduction-to-practice evidence for Claims 1-2 (O(k) WOTS+), 4-5 (Base17, ContinuID), 8 (multi-isotope), 12-14 (ContinuID chain), 21 (multi-isotope dispatch).

generate_secret.description: Deterministic secret from a seed: SHAKE256(seed) squeezed to length/2 bytes (length=2048 hex chars -> 1024 bytes -> 2048 hex). All SDKs MUST produce this exact value. Cross-SDK parity lock (Batch AO, 2026-06-04).

atom_value_format.description: An atom V/B/F numeric value MUST serialize as an integer string (the validator parses it as i128); whole-number floats carry NO trailing '.0'. JS String(n) is canonical; all SDKs MUST match. Cross-SDK parity lock (Batch AQ, 2026-06-05).

continuid_chain.description: ContinuID identity relay: two sequential wallet positions from same secret. Position2 is SHAKE256(position1, 256). Patent Claims 5, 12-14.

base17_enumeration.description: Hex-to-Base17 conversion used in WOTS+ signature indexing. Base17 digits: 0-9, a-g. Patent Claim 5.

multi_isotope_molecule.description: Multiple isotope types (V, M, I) in a single molecule, each with position-derived wallet addresses. Patent Claims 8, 21.

bigint_carry_edge.description: Edge cases in BigInt arithmetic during SHAKE256 hashing and key generation. Tests 65-char hex (overflow), max values, boundary values. Patent Claim 5.

wots_roundtrip.description: Full WOTS+ sign/verify roundtrip. The OTS address is the protocol wallet address: hash each 128-char key chunk 16 times, join the 16 public fragments, then digest = SHAKE256(joined, 8192) and address = SHAKE256(digest, 256). This two-pass derivation matches generate_address and CheckMolecule.ots (the address the validator verifies against). Patent Claims 1-2, 5.

tests.name: deterministic_roundtrip
tests.otsAddressDerivation: For each of 16 key chunks (128 chars): hash chunk 16 times with SHAKE256(chunk, 512). Join all 16 public fragments, then digest = SHAKE256(joined, 8192) and address = SHAKE256(digest, 256). This two-pass derivation is the protocol address (generate_address / CheckMolecule.ots) and equals continuid_chain.expectedAddress1 for the same secret+position.

buffer_deposit_conservation.description: init_deposit_buffer (B-isotope buffer deposit) debits the FULL source balance for UTXO conservation (JS/PHP/TS reference); a partial deposit must still conserve. Emitted atoms (in order): source V = -sourceBalance, buffer B = +amount (metaType walletBundle), remainder V = +(sourceBalance-amount) (metaType walletBundle). The sum of all V+B atom values MUST equal 0 (the validator's b_isotope conservation check). Cross-SDK parity lock (Batch BF, 2026-06-08). Rust+Python previously debited only -amount, making partial deposits non-conserving (validator-rejected); fixed to match JS/PHP/TS.

buffer_withdraw_conservation.description: init_withdraw_buffer (B-isotope buffer withdraw) debits the FULL source balance for UTXO conservation (JS/PHP/TS/Kotlin/C++ reference); a partial withdraw must still conserve. Emitted atoms (in order): source B = -sourceBalance (metaType walletBundle), recipient V = +amount (metaType walletBundle), remainder B = +(sourceBalance-amount) (metaType walletBundle). The sum of all V+B atom values MUST equal 0 (the validator's b_isotope conservation check). Cross-SDK parity lock (cycle 148, 2026-06-28) — the withdraw analog of buffer_deposit_conservation. Rust+Python previously debited only -total/-amount, making partial withdraws non-conserving; fixed to match JS/PHP/TS/Kotlin/C++.

buffer_conservation_negative.description: NEGATIVE cases: buffer molecules every SDK must REJECT. The two conservation vectors above only assert that VALID molecules are accepted, and that gap concealed a live fail-open defect — Kotlin gated its V-only conservation on the presence of B/F atoms (stating 'the B/F atoms own the cross-isotope conservation') while having no isotopeB or isotopeF to own it, so a molecule destroying value verified clean and passed every positive vector. A validator never observed rejecting is indistinguishable from an absent one; these vectors make the SDK demonstrate the rejection. Added 2026-07-27.
buffer_conservation_negative.recipe: Do NOT hand-assemble atoms: a hand-built molecule is refused by unrelated checks (atom index, self-transfer) before conservation is ever evaluated, so the test passes while proving nothing. Instead build a VALID molecule with the SDK's own init_deposit_buffer/init_withdraw_buffer, apply the single `tamper` mutation below, re-sign, and assert the molecule is rejected. Tamper targets: firstV/lastV/firstB/lastB select the first or last atom of that isotope in emission order.

tests.name: unbalanced_deposit_remainder
tests.reason: remainder 70 -> 50 makes V+B sum -20 instead of 0; value is destroyed

tests.name: unbalanced_withdraw_remainder
tests.reason: remainder 70 -> 50 makes B+V sum -20 instead of 0; value is destroyed

tests.name: deposit_inflates_remainder
tests.reason: remainder 70 -> 90 makes V+B sum +20; value is created out of nothing

token_replenish.description: replenishToken mints additional supply of an EXISTING token with a C atom (the minting isotope), never with V atoms. Emitted atoms (in order): C (signed by the identity's USER wallet exactly like the SDK's own createToken C atom; metaType 'token', metaId = token slug, value = +amount for fungible or the new unit count for stackable/non-fungible; metas in order: action = 'add', then address/position/pubkey of the credited wallet (the identity's existing wallet for the token, or a new one), batchId only when that wallet has one, tokenUnits only for stackable/non-fungible), then the SDK's standard I ContinuID remainder atom. Validator 0.6.0 accepts it only from the token's creator bundle, for supply 'infinite' or 'replenishable', crediting the creator's own bundle. Replaces the historical 2-V replenish (V(+amount), V(+(balance+amount))) that JS/TS/PHP/Rust built and every CheckMolecule rejects. Cross-SDK parity lock (Phase B, validator 0.6.0 / SDK patch wave, 2026-09-26).

stackable_fusion_conservation.description: fuseToken fuses M >= 2 units of a stackable token held by the source wallet (balance B = unit count, B >= M) into ONE new unit N delivered to the recipient bundle. Emitted atoms (in order): source V = -B (tokenUnits = the M fused units in the source order: the SENT set; the kept units appear only on the remainder atom); burn V = +(M-1) (metaType walletBundle, metaId = 64 zeros, tokenUnits = the fused ids except the LAST, caller order); F = +1 (metaType walletBundle, metaId = recipient bundle, tokenUnits = [N] where N.metas.fusedTokenUnits = the full triples of all M fused units, caller order); remainder V = +(B-M) (metaType walletBundle, metaId = sender bundle, tokenUnits = the source units minus the fused ones, source order; emitted even when B = M with value 0 and tokenUnits []). No I (ContinuID) atom: like transferToken and burnToken, the molecule is signed by the source token wallet at its own position, and the validator requires any I-bearing molecule to sign at the ContinuID pointer. The sum of all V+F values MUST equal 0; the last fused unit is absorbed by the F atom (validator 0.6.0 tombstones it and inserts N). Source units are U1..U5 (triples [id, id, {}]) unless the test lists sourceUnits; N id is 'FUSED'. Cross-SDK parity lock (Phase B, validator 0.6.0 / SDK patch wave, 2026-09-26).

buffer_withdraw_fresh_remainder.description: init_withdraw_buffer after validator 0.6.1 / SDK patch wave (contract 9.6): the source B atom is the actual buffer wallet S (Balance(type: buffer)), value -S.balance; one addressless recipient V = +amount per recipient (metaType walletBundle, metaId recipient bundle); the remainder B = +(S.balance-amount) goes to S.createRemainder(secret), a FRESH position that MUST differ from S's position (a remainder at the signing position is credited behind a consumed one-time key and is stranded; validator 0.6.1 rejects it with 'Value may not be credited to a consumed signing position'). No I atom. Emitted even when the remainder value is 0. Sum of V+B values MUST be 0.

create_token_units.description: createToken with units sends the C atom meta tokenUnits as compact [id, name, metas] triples. A bare id string is sent as [id, id, {}]; a triple or unit object keeps its own name and metas ({} when absent). Value = unit count; amount must be null or 0.
